newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia govt paper market value up to 231.6 tln rbs.
newsitem.headline: Russia govt paper market value up to 231.6 tln rbs.

text.p: The market value of Russian government securities in circulation rose to 231.61 trillion roubles on January 31 from 228.63 trillion roubles on January 24, the central bank said on Monday.
The market value of GKO discount Treasury bills rose to 193.01 trillion roubles from 192.01 trillion roubles, it said in a statement.
The market value of OFZ interest-bearing bonds rose to 38.60 trillion roubles from 36.61 trillion roubles, it said.
The nominal value of all government paper in circulation rose to 248.45 trillion roubles on January 31 from 246.52 trillion roubles on January 24.
